title: CNC and Laser Job Runtime and Queue
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cnc:job
| stats sum(runtime_s) as run_s, count as jobs, sum(eval(if(state="queued",1,0))) as queued by machine
| eval run_hours=round(run_s/3600,1)
| sort - run_hours
description: Tracks runtime and the pending queue for your CNC or laser so you can plan the shop's workload and material.
value: Knowing machine hours and backlog helps schedule cuts, order stock, and time consumable replacement before a big job.
implementation: Ingest CNC/laser job records; schedule daily and review runtime and queue per machine.
visualization: Table of machines with total runtime, job count, and queue depth.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how long your cutting machines run and how many jobs are waiting, so you can plan your projects.
